description: The plot illustrates the Average Repetition Rate across different Relation Categories for three distinct configurations and their respective averages. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate," also uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A solid blue line with circular markers (whose legend label is obscured) fluctuates significantly across the x-axis, starting at approximately 0.25 at x=0, reaching prominent peaks at x=1 (0.60), x=22 (0.43), and x=31 (0.62), and ending at approximately 0.05 at x=64. A corresponding thin, dashed blue line representing the "Average of w/o DPO obo" remains constant at a y-value of 0.163 across the entire plot. A solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers, labeled "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," starts at roughly 0.14, exhibits high variability with major peaks at x=31 (0.59) and x=46 (0.46), and ends at approximately 0.15. Its corresponding average is shown as a thin, dashed orange line labeled "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," which remains steady at 0.227. Finally, a solid green line with star markers, labeled "DPO," begins at approximately 0.16, shows less extreme fluctuation compared to the other solid lines with a notable peak at x=1 (0.28) and a low at x=9 (0.01), and concludes at roughly 0.08. The thin, dashed green line representing the "Average of DPO" maintains a constant horizontal trajectory at 0.117.
